'''Jhensara''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. During a trip to the [[Thrynka system/Legends|Thrynka system]], she was caught in an [[Asteroid storm/Legends|asteroid storm]] that forced her to deploy her three [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] [[Artoo (Jhensara)|Artoo]], [[Arfive (Jhensara)|Arfive]], and [[Arthree (Jhensara)|Arthree]] to repair the damage.<ref name="The History of R-Series Astromech Droids" />
